personality_one_liner: A warm, appetizing, and highly legible iOS-native ordering experience that makes buying party combos fast and intuitive.

spacing.rule: Handle spacing correctly dont have extra spaces where its not required, handle padding and margin corectly and subtle for buttons and components

do's: Sticky headers over scrolling catalog list
Featured combo card text overlays (Apple-style blur)

screens.name: Home / Catálogo
screens.purpose: Showcase appetizing combos and menus, driving users to build their party order.

states.loading: Skeleton grids representing category chips and product cards.
states.error: Failed to load menu. Retry button.

screens.layout: Sticky header with logo and cart icon. Horizontal scrolling category chips (Combos, Fritos, Congelados). Vertical list of product cards with appetizing images. Use '50 em 50' badges on fried items using brandTertiary background. Cards use single column, 100% width minus padding, to let food photography shine.

screens.name: Combo Builder (Product Detail)
screens.purpose: Allow users to assemble their 50-by-50 combinations flawlessly.
screens.layout: Full screen sheet or modal. Hero image at top with gradient scrim. Steppers for different flavors (Coxinha, Kibe, etc.). A sticky floating bar at the bottom showing a progress meter out of 50 (e.g., '30/50 Selecionados') and the 'Adicionar' CTA button which is disabled until the count reaches a multiple of 50.

screens.name: Carrinho & Checkout
screens.purpose: Streamlined guest checkout for rapid ordering.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty basket + 'Adicionar salgados' CTA.
states.error: Validation error text inline near missing fields.

screens.layout: List of cart items at top. Form fields below for Guest details (Nome, Celular, Endereço completo). Segmented control or radio list for payment (Pix, Dinheiro c/ troco, Cartão na Entrega). Sticky primary CTA 'Finalizar Pedido' at the bottom.

screens.name: Pedidos & Rastreamento (Order Status)
screens.purpose: Real-time visibility into order prep and live motoboy tracking.
screens.layout: Top half: vertical timeline (Recebido -> Fritando -> Saiu -> Entregue). If 'Saiu', transition top half to a live map view with a custom Motoboy marker. Bottom half: Order summary card overlaid on map using Glassmorphism.

screens.name: Área Admin / Motoboy
screens.purpose: Operational control for staff (hidden behind password login in profile).

states.empty: No active orders for motoboy / kanban empty.

screens.layout: Simple list of assigned orders for Motoboy with large 'Iniciar Entrega' (triggers GPS tracking). Admin sees a Kanban board (Novos, Fritando, Entrega) to manage workflow.

hero_coxinha_combo.alt: A black plate topped with fresh Brazilian coxinhas

hero_salgadinhos_basket.alt: Basket filled with traditional Brazilian snacks

hero_combo_fritos.alt: Combo tray of fried snacks and sauces

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. Use the Rust/Cinnamon base (#C24127) as primary CTA color to stimulate appetite. Do not use generic reds.
Implement the '50 by 50' logic robustly in the Combo Builder screen. Provide a clear visual progress meter for the user (e.g., '10/50').
Use Phosphor icons. Sizes must be restricted to 12, 16, 20, 24, 32, or 48. Do NOT mix styles.
The Guest Checkout flow should use un-authenticated state management for saving address and phone numbers locally for the next time.
Ensure the tracker map has a custom marker for the motoboy and provides an Apple-style blur glass sheet over the bottom to show order metadata.
Add a discrete button/link in the Perfil section for Admin/Motoboy login, shielded by a simple password input to route to internal stack.
